kicker: WORKS AT PARTIES, WEDDINGS, WORK EVENTS
title: How to join a group *mid-conversation*

label: MISTAKE
head: Walking up with a joke ready
sub: You break the flow and make it about you.

label: STEP 1
head: Listen for 20 seconds first
sub: Smile, nod, figure out what they're actually talking about.

label: STEP 2
head: Ask: "What's the story behind that?"
sub: Someone retells it and pulls you right in.

label: STEP 3
head: Let them talk, then add one thing
sub: A follow-up question beats your best story.

text: You don't need to be the *most interesting* guy in the group to belong in it.
